picks.title: Lightning Labs Urges Immediate Updates Over Certificate Vulnerability
picks.summary: New binaries block trust in compromised eMudhra certificate keys. Updating Go on a host alone does not patch software already installed.

picks.title: GPUs from Nvidia RTX 5090 stolen $470,000 shipment from Brazil airport appear for sale online, identified by serial numbers
picks.summary: One of the GPUs from a stolen shipment of RTX 5090 graphics cards has appeared for sale online. Police have identified three employees at an airport who stole the goods.

picks.title: GitLab warns of new max severity code execution vulnerability
picks.summary: GitLab has released security patches for a maximum-severity Regular Expression Compiler flaw that can let remote attackers run arbitrary code on vulnerable servers. [...]

picks.title: Several Linux Kernel Vulnerabilities Accidentally Posted To Public Kernel Mailing List
picks.summary: Seemingly as an accident, overnight several new Linux kernel vulnerability reports were posted to the public Linux kernel mailing list rather than the private security mailing list. The vulnerabilities have yet to be patched on mainline but at least in some cases there are patches undergoing testing

picks.title: Researchers Flag Swell Rate Manipulation After Railway Key-Drain Warning
picks.summary: Researchers flagged inflated swETH and rswETH rates after the cloud-platform disclosure; the reported 2,513 ETH held by Swell is not a confirmed loss.

picks.title: 480,000 phishing emails sent from a PC hidden behind a fridge in a Japanese hotel room
picks.summary: Almost 500,000 phishing emails were sent from a PC hidden behind a fridge in a Kobe, Japan, hotel room.
